newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Hi Cement rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Hi Cement rated a buy.

text.p: Manila brokerage house Angping & Associates Securities Inc on Tuesday said it rated Hi Cement Corp a buy, citing a timely expansion programme that will benefit from projected strong demand for cement.
In a research paper, Angping said that the completion of Hi Cement's new finish mills will be just in time for the increased demand for cement during the summer season.
Cement sales are projected to reach eight million bags of cement per month from 4.6 million in January and 4.2 million last month, the securities firm said.
Angping added that Hi Cement's aggressive expansion into institutional accounts reduces its dependence on dealers to market its cement and assures the company of a ready market.

"We believe HCC at this point is still undervalued. With a price earnings-to-growth ratio of only 0.34, we believe that the issue still has an upside potential of 44 percent on a target price of 15 pesos per share," said Warren Chua, Angping analyst.
On Monday, Hi Cement closed at 10.25 pesos, down 25 centavos.
